references.text: Describes that trumpets are to be blown on the new moon days, which is the same feast mentioned in Num 28:11
The daily burnt offering that forms the basis for the additional offerings on the new moon day
David organized the Levites to serve at the burnt offerings on the new moon days
Solomon planned to build the temple for burnt offerings on the new moon days
Solomon offered burnt offerings on the new moon days according to Moses' command
Hezekiah ensured burnt offerings on the new moon days as written in the law of the Lord
After the exile, the people resumed the burnt offerings on the new moon days
Nehemiah organized collections for the new moon offerings
Ezekiel's future temple also has offerings on the new moon day with bulls, rams, and lambs
Paul mentions new moon days as a shadow of what was to come in Christ
